description: Recommend a Bay Run specialist (guard, sentiment, support tickets, document reranking) or a warm direct job (toxicity, embeddings, multilingual sentiment) from the same table find_runnable uses. Bay Run is a separate, provisional service that may fail under load. Returns a Pin id or direct call and the weight/byte status as recorded (hashes may be null); no decoder-only VRAM estimate. Not a catalog file download.
name: recommend_specialist
